description: Every PatchLoop SDK must reproduce each expected decision and reason exactly, refuse to load every invalid rule set and every invalid rule set text, and hash each rule set to the listed value. Lookups, when given, must match exactly, in order.

cases.note: Integer 7 is not equal to string "7".
2^53 is outside the exact integer range of every SDK.
A pointer that does not resolve counts as absent.
On an object, every token is a key, including "0".

invalid_rulesets.why: Binding must name a defined resource
Parent links must not revisit a resource
access must be public, authenticated or scoped
A public tool is allowed before consent is checked
missing_resource is not part of the rule set format

invalid_ruleset_texts.why: A reviewer reads consent true; a parser keeps consent false
Duplicate keys are refused at every level
